blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Michele Gumabao put a premium on confidence in Creamline’s big win over Choco Mucho to advance to the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series Finals. Gumabao was instrumental for Creamline as part of the second unit, dropping 11 points as Creamline eliminated its sister team, 21-25, 25-17, 25-17, 25-23, in the semifinals on Tuesday at the Philsports Arena.
